extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: airport passenger stair truck, approx. 2.5 x 6.7 x 4.8 m, platform height 3.6 m
extras.notes: ground support vehicle: yellow chassis with cab at the front (-Y), blue stair flight with rubber treads and yellow nosings, handrails both sides, platform with bumper above the cab, amber beacon (emissive, not baked). Moving parts: airplane-stairs_flight (stair, platform and lift rods, origin on the rear hinge pin, rotate around local X, negative raises the platform, about -4 to +3 degrees), airplane-stairs_wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr (origin at the hub, spin around local X); lift cylinders move with the stair and dip into the lift housing on the deck; no text, no airline colours

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
